Hi Jenny,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through the low-latency inference use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of customer need:
- Replace current batch scoring for fraud signals with a sub-200ms per-request inference path for the online risk flow.
- Tight budget targets: target endpoint cost no more than $120 per 1M inferences for the pilot (we'll refine).
- Compliance: audit logs retention and KMS-backed key management are must-haves.

Stakeholders we identified on the call: 
- Jenny Tan — Champion / Dir. Data Product (you)
- Carlos Mendez — probable economic buyer (SVP Eng)
- Procurement (you said you would loop them in)
- Security contact — unknown (we'll need to get a name/email)

Decision criteria we heard: latency SLO, predictable per-token / per-request unit economics, ability to run in-cloud with VPC controls, and SOC2 evidence for audit.

Short-term proposal (pilot):
- 6-week pilot (Proof-of-Value) targeting the online risk path (1 endpoint).
- Deliverables: integration guide, observable SLO dashboard, cost/latency report, and a short report showing ROI vs current batch approach.
- Next steps: 
  1) Tech deep-dive with Ben (30-45m) to align on infra and auth (can we do Tue 3/24 11:00 PT?).
  2) I will send: trial plan (attached), an SOW draft, and a one-page ROI summary you can share with Carlos.
  3) Please introduce your procurement and security contacts to us so we can surface SOC2/KMS details.

Attached: Redwood-trial-plan.xlsx (pilot milestone plan).

One-sheeter / quick talk track for internal champion (Jenny) — short bullets you can use with Carlos/Procurement: 
- "We can validate a production inference path in 6 weeks with measurable latency and cost delta vs our batch jobs."
- "Redwood offers VPC/private deploy options and KMS integration for key control; audit logs are surfaced via the Console."
- "Pilot gets us quantifiable ROI: expected 20-35% lower operational cost in the online path and faster decisioning for fraud scoring."

I'll follow up with the SOW and ROI one-pager tomorrow.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive with Ben.

Best,

Hi Jenny / Rachel,

Thanks for the call — notes and immediate action items below. I've attached the SOC2 evidence checklist and a quick architecture sketch for the pilot.

Key technical assumptions and recommendations:
- Auth & Networking: Recommend SAML SSO + VPC connector for secure ingress. For pilot we can use customer-managed VPC peering, or a hosted VPC with strict allow-lists.
- KMS: Redwood supports customer KMS (AWS KMS/HSM) for model encryption. We'll provide key wrap docs and a sample KMS policy.
- Observability: Console provides per-route latency p50/p95, and token-level cost breakdown. We'll export a weekly cost/latency CSV for the pilot.
- Performance: With the proposed quantization + batching profile we expect p95 below 180ms at the projected pilot throughput (~50 rps burst).

Action items:
1) Rachel to share SOW + ROI (done).
2) BrightBank to confirm security contact and procurement contact (Jenny: done).
3) Ben to send SOC2-evidence-list.docx and pilot infra sketch (attached).
4) Redwood to prepare a short Demo + runbook for the first week of pilot onboarding.
